 Order

Accused in S.C.No.10009/2023 pending before the Court of IV Addl. District & Sessions Judge,
Doddaballapura arising out of Crime No.48/2023 registered by the Doddabelavangala Police Station, Bengaluru District for the offences punishable under Sections 498A & 304B of IPC is before this Court seeking regular bail.

entities.text:
Court of IV Addl. District & Sessions Judge,
Doddaballapura
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. Heard the learned counsel appearing for the parties 3.
On the basis of complaint lodged by Sri Thirupathaiah S/o Late Gangaiah, FIR in Crime No.48/2023 was lodged by Doddabelavangala Police Station against the petitioner for the aforesaid offences.
During the course of investigation, the petitioner was arrested on 27.03.2023.

Investigation in the case is complete and charge sheet has been filed and the case is now pending before the jurisdictional sessions court in S.C.No.10009/2023.
4.
The bail application filed by the petitioner before the jurisdictional Sessions Court in Crl.Misc.No.10096/2023 was rejected on 03.06.2023.
It is under these circumstances, the petitioner is before this court.
Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner having reiterated the grounds urged in the petition prays to allow the petition.
6. Per contra, learned High Court Government Pleader has opposed the bail application.

7. The material on record would go to show that marriage of the petitioner with the deceased Arundhati who is the daughter of the complainant had taken place about 6 years prior to the date of complaint.
From the said wedlock, the couple have a son who is aged about 5 years.
Deceased Arundhati had hanged herself in the house on 26.03.2023 and had died.
8. The postmortem report of the deceased would go to show that the death was as a result of asphyxia due to hanging.

Though allegation is made against the petitioner that he was allegedly demanding payment of dowry from the complainant's daughter, prima-facie it appears there is no material on record to show that such demand was made by the petitioner.
The offences punishable under the dowry prohibition act are not invoked in the charge sheet against the petitioner.

sentences.text:
For the purpose of attracting offence punishable under Section 304B of IPC,
there should be material to show that the deceased was being ill-treated by her husband or his relatives in furtherance of their demand for payment of dowry.
The allegation in the charge sheet against the petitioner with regard to demand of dowry is required to be proved in full-fledged trial.
The petitioner who is an agriculturist has no criminal antecedents and he is custody from 27.03.2023.
Therefore, I am of the considered view that the petitioner's prayer for granting regular bail is required to be allowed.
9. In view of the above, the petition is allowed.
